recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist composition featuring a vertical rectangular photograph of a man's silhouette against a warm sunset, positioned on the left side of a large white field, balanced by flush-left sans-serif typography on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between the dark silhouette and the glowing sun orb
Asymmetrical balance between the framed image and the text block
Color coordination between the sunset's orange-red hues and the primary text color
Geometric tension between the sharp rectangular frame and the organic cloud shapes
coreInvariants: Profile silhouette of a male figure
Single bright sun orb visible through clouds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Vertical photo frame occupies the left-center; subject is a waist-up profile silhouette.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright sun orb acts as the primary focal point within the photo frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the sun, moves to the silhouette profile, then follows the gaze rightward to the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding the central elements, creating a clean, breathable layout.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange and deep red (sunset and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the photo; low saturation in the background to emphasize the warm-toned focal points.

characterSpecificRedesigns: None; relies on standard geometric proportions

composition.relationshipToImage: Adjacent, aligned with the top of the photo frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight contrast within the same typeface family (light vs. bold).
graphicDevices: Thin rectangular border around the photograph
Horizontal rule separating artist name from title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a minimalist layout with a large off-white background. On the left, place a vertical rectangular photo of a man in profile silhouette against a deep orange sunset with a visible sun orb. The photo should have a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text to the right of the photo. Use a mix of light and bold weights. The text should be flush-left and colored in a deep burnt red that matches the sunset.

verificationChecks: Is the silhouette completely dark without internal detail?
Is the sun orb a distinct bright circle?
Is there a clear hierarchy between the light and bold text?

adjustableVariables: Width of the white border around the photo
Proportion of negative space on the right
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the silhouette
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the silhouette is a clean profile.
Check that the text color harmonizes with the sunset.
Verify the off-white background is consistent and clean.
Confirm the geometric sans-serif is used in all-caps.
recipe.reuseFormula: Place a high-contrast silhouette photo in a vertical frame on the left of a neutral field, then balance it with a block of color-coordinated, flush-left geometric sans-serif typography on the right.
